item.title: BREAKING: Rivers Chief Judge declines to set up panel to probe Gov Fubara
item.description: Rivers State Chief Judge, Simeon Amadi, has refused to set up a judicial panel to investigate Governor Siminalayi Fubara, citing an existing court order.
